description: This file defines a React functional component named ModelGroupAliasSettings that manages model group alias configurations. It includes state management, effect hooks, input handling, and interaction with backend APIs for creating, updating, and deleting aliases, as well as rendering a UI for alias management.

methods.name: saveAliasesToBackend
methods.description: Sends the updated list of aliases to the backend API to persist changes and optionally calls the callback onAliasUpdate.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new alias, updates backend, and manages UI state.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias to be edited for inline editing UI.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Saves updates to an existing alias to the backend and updates UI state.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing mode for an alias.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Deletes an alias, updates backend, and manages UI accordingly.
